title: No drinking water in village
text: The hand pump in our village has been broken for 3 months. We have to walk 5km to fetch water. NITI Aayog survey found contamination.

title: Pani ki samasya gaon mein
text: Hamare gaon mein kuan sukh gaya hai. Peene ka pani bilkul nahi hai. Sarkar se nivedan hai ki nal se pani dijiye.

title: Borewell contaminated with iron
text: The borewell water in our colony turns clothes orange. The iron content is way too high. Children are getting sick.

title: No hospital in 50km radius
text: The nearest hospital is 50 kilometers away. Pregnant women have died during transit. We need a primary health center.

title: Aspatal ki zaroorat hai
text: Hamare block mein koi doctor nahi hai. Bimari mein log 60km door jate hain. Bahut logo ki raste mein maut ho chuki hai.

title: Sadak bahut kharab hai
text: Hamare gaon ki sadak mein bahut bade ghadde hain. Barish mein rasta bilkul band ho jata hai. Ambulance nahi aa sakti.

title: Pothole-ridden road causing accidents
text: Our main village road has severe potholes causing frequent vehicle accidents. The road has not been repaired in 5 years despite multiple complaints.

title: Bijli nahi aati
text: Hamare gaon mein roz 12-14 ghante bijli nahi rehti. Generator nahi hai. Baccho ki padhai kharab ho rahi hai. Motor bhi nahi chalti.

title: No electricity for months
text: Our village has been without electricity for 4 months since the transformer burned down. No one from DISCOM has visited.

title: School mein teacher nahi hai
text: Hamare primary school mein sirf ek teacher hai. 5 class padhaana mushkil hai. Bacche padh nahi paate. Dropout badh raha hai.

title: No teachers in government school
text: Our government school has 4 vacant teacher posts. Children sit idle for hours. Class 8 dropout rate has exceeded 40%.

title: Fasal kharab ho rahi hai
text: Sookha padne se hamare khet ki fasal barbaad ho gayi hai. Koi bima nahi mila. Bank ne loan bhi nahi diya. Kisan bahut pareshan hain.

title: Crop loss due to unseasonal rain
text: Unseasonal rain has destroyed our standing wheat crop. No crop insurance has been disbursed. The mandi price has also crashed.

title: Air pollution from factory
text: The cement factory near our village discharges black dust 24 hours a day. Children have developed asthma. Air quality is extremely poor.

title: Nadi mein kachra daal rahe hain
text: Kaarkhane ka ganda paani seedha nadi mein ja raha hai. Machhliyan mar rahi hain. Hamare bacche usi paani se nahate hain. Bahut bimari ho rahi hai.

title: Unemployment among youth
text: More than 60% of youth in our block are unemployed. There are no factories or industries nearby. MGNREGA work is only for 30 days.

title: Kaam nahi milta
text: Gaon ke nojawan khali baithte hain. Koi rozgar nahi hai. Bahut log shehar chale gaye hain. MSME ya udyog khulne chahiye yahan.

title: Government certificate takes 6 months
text: Getting a birth certificate from the municipal office takes 6 months and 5 visits. There is no online portal. Everything is manual.

title: Panchayat building nahi hai
text: Hamare gram panchayat ke paas apna koi karyalay nahi hai. Meetings khule mein hoti hain. Sarkaari dastavezon ko rakhne ki jagah nahi hai.

title: Thackeray heritage site deteriorating
text: The 18th-century fort in our district is crumbling due to neglect. Tourists have declined. No restoration funds have been allocated.

title: Flood relief not reaching victims
text: After the flood last month, relief material has not reached our village. The bridge is broken. Police are blocking the road. People are starving.

title: Chhath Puja ghat mein kachra
text: Chhath Puja ke baad ghat par bahut saari gandagi reh jaati hai. Sarkaar ne safai ka koi intezam nahi kiya. Paryatan per asar pad raha hai.

title: Mental health support absent in tribal area
text: Tribal youth in our block have no access to mental health services. Three suicides last year. Nearest psychiatrist is in the state capital.

title: Solar panels not working
text: The 50 solar panels installed on our school 2 years ago are non-functional. No maintenance contract. Grid power is also unreliable.

title: No cold storage facility for farmers
text: Farmers lose 40% of their vegetables within 24 hours of harvest due to no cold storage. Mandi prices crash during harvest season.

title: Swachh Bharat toilet not built
text: Our village was promised toilets under Swachh Bharat Mission. Money was sanctioned 3 years ago but construction never happened. People still defecate in open.

title: Mahila suraksha ki samasya
text: Hamare yahan mahilaon ko raat mein bahar nikalna bahut assurakshit lagta hai. Street light nahi hai. Kuch haadse bhi ho chuke hain.

title: FIR not registered by police
text: We went to the police station to file an FIR about a land dispute but they refused to register it. We have video evidence. No legal aid available.

title: Skill training center closed
text: The ITI training center in our block closed 2 years ago. Youth have no vocational skills. Employers cannot find skilled workers locally.

title: Mining company destroying forest
text: An illegal quarrying operation is cutting down forest cover near our village. Wildlife is displaced. River siltation has increased drastically.

title: Internet nahi hai gaon mein
text: Hamare gaon mein mobile network bhi nahi aata. Online school nahi kar sakte. Sarkari portal se form bhi nahi bhar sakte. 4G tower chahiye.

title: Housing scheme money misused
text: PMAY housing money was sanctioned for 50 families but only 10 houses were built. Rest of the funds were misused by local contractors.

title: Small business loans not approved
text: MSME entrepreneurs in our area cannot get bank loans due to lack of collateral. Mudra Yojana is on paper only. Startups are dying.

title: Dengue outbreak in ward
text: Dengue fever has affected more than 200 people in our ward this monsoon. Fogging has not happened. Standing water in broken drains.

title: Ambiguous: school building leaking
text: The school building roof leaks every monsoon. Students cannot sit in class. Mid-day meals also get spoiled.

title: Very short: no water
text: No water.

title: Off-taxonomy: political complaint
text: The ruling party candidate is rigging the panchayat election. This is voter fraud. Officials are bribed.

title: Spelling errors and Hinglish
text: Hamre gaon mein handpamp toot gya hai. Peena wala paani nahi h. Pls help kr dijiye. Garmi mein bahut takleef h.

title: Cross-domain: flood destroyed crops and road
text: The flash flood last week destroyed our standing paddy crop and washed away the bridge. We cannot reach the mandi and food is rotting.

title: Anganwadi mein poshan nahi
text: Anganwadi kendra band rehta hai zyada tar. Bacchon ko poshan nahi milta. Maa aur shishu ka wajan bahut kam hai. Nurse bhi nahi aati.

title: Duplicate problem: hand pump broken again
text: The hand pump repaired 6 months ago has broken again. This is the 5th time in 2 years. Villagers are frustrated and tired of complaining.

title: Low information: problem in my area
text: There is a big problem in our area. It is very bad. Please look into it.

title: Climate change affecting agriculture
text: Rainfall has become unpredictable. Crops fail every alternate year. Old irrigation channels are no longer sufficient. Farmers need climate-resilient seeds.

title: Sarkari portal kaam nahi karta
text: Ration card portal pe OTP nahi aata. Grievance portal mein complain submit nahi hoti. Sab digital hone ka koi fayda nahi agar system hi nahi chalta.
